state_rules.direct-observation: Explicit depth with resolvable evidence entries and no depth interval
state_rules.bounded-inference: Explicit unverified depth with resolvable evidence and a lower-upper interval
state_rules.unsupported-claim: Explicit depth with missing evidence, an undeclared evidence reference, or a missing repository file
state_rules.unresolved-field: Declared default with unverified depth and no evidence

most_comprehensive.condition: Own explained lower bound exceeds every external explained upper bound
most_comprehensive.correction_window: Public 30-day correction window must be completed

most_detailed.condition: At least 12 own tracks are executable or assessed and own worked lower bound exceeds every external worked upper bound
most_detailed.correction_window: Public 30-day correction window must be completed

excluded_by_design: No ranking on a topic left unresolved by a provider
No re-scoring of any provider or the independent reading
No inference that a laboratory state measures teaching quality
No inference that a default unknown means the provider lacks the topic
